known_information: The issue explains that a detached std::thread loses its native handle, so the subsequent TerminateThread attempt cannot reliably stop it.
Transient NtQueryObject stalls can let old workers overlap while sharing caller-owned containers/buffers; a permanent hang is not required.
Current source gives abandoned name-query workers a reference-counted independent heap block and transfers handle ownership instead of sharing freed caller memory.
